facts.text: ISO 34505:2025 test-case evaluation, the NATM multi-pillar approach and academic falsification literature provide established practice supporting separation of test campaigns by purpose, data and governance; the standards evidence is on-road evidence.
facts.quote: Established practice in ISO 34505:2025 test-case evaluation, the NATM multi-pillar approach and the academic falsification literature converges on three campaign classes

facts.text: The campaign synthesis recommends three classes—discovery or challenge testing, performance-estimation testing, and requirement and regression testing—with separate purposes, separate data and separate governance.
facts.quote: three campaign classes with separate purposes, separate data and separate governance.

facts.text: Discovery or challenge testing includes combinatorial designs, DOE screening, boundary testing, adversarial perturbations, falsification, Adaptive Stress Testing, corner-case replay and searches around known failures.
facts.quote: contains combinatorial designs, DOE screening, boundary testing, adversarial perturbations, falsification, Adaptive Stress Testing, corner-case replay and searches around known failures.

facts.text: Discovery or challenge testing seeks to determine whether the system can be broken and where its weak regions are.
facts.quote: It answers "can we break it, and where are the weak regions?"

facts.text: A discovery or challenge testing failure percentage must never be reported as an operational failure rate; the test pool must be labeled "not for rate estimation".
facts.quote: Its failure percentage must never be reported as an operational failure rate; label the pool "not for rate estimation".

facts.text: Performance-estimation testing uses a frozen, stratified random sample drawn from the declared operating-domain distribution before tuning starts.
facts.quote: Performance-estimation testing** is a frozen, stratified random sample drawn from the declared operating-domain distribution before tuning starts

facts.text: Performance-estimation testing stores a fixed seed and content hash in the test-management system.
facts.quote: with a fixed seed and content hash stored in the test-management system.

facts.text: Performance-estimation testing freezes weighting and estimators before results are inspected.
facts.quote: The weighting and estimators are frozen before results are inspected.

facts.text: Performance-estimation testing estimates how often the system succeeds or nuisance-triggers in a defined operational population.
facts.quote: It answers "how often does it succeed or nuisance-trigger in a defined operational population?"

facts.text: Requirement and regression testing contains deterministic pass/fail cases tied to individual safety and functional requirements.
facts.quote: Requirement and regression testing** contains deterministic pass/fail cases tied to individual safety and functional requirements.

facts.text: Requirement and regression testing determines whether a software or calibration change has broken required behaviour.
facts.quote: It answers "did this software or calibration change break a required behaviour?"

facts.text: Requirement and regression testing is rerun continually.
facts.quote: It is rerun continually

facts.text: Requirement and regression testing is neither a random population estimate nor a failure-seeking sample.
facts.quote: is neither a random population estimate nor a failure-seeking sample.

facts.text: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119 separates test processes, design techniques and documentation.
facts.quote: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119 separates test processes, design techniques and documentation

facts.text: ISO 34505 requires structured test-case identifiers, objectives, inputs, platform and expected results.
facts.quote: ISO 34505 requires structured test-case identifiers, objectives, inputs, platform and expected results.

facts.text: A failure found by search should become a new logical scenario or a permanent regression test, rather than a data point for performance estimation.
facts.quote: Found failures become scenario knowledge, not data points.** A failure found by search becomes a new logical scenario or a permanent regression test.

facts.text: The frequency of a failure found by search is estimated separately, using sampling or importance sampling with known weights.
facts.quote: Its frequency is estimated separately, by sampling or by importance sampling with known weights.

facts.text: An importance-sampled campaign qualifies as performance-estimation testing only when both operational and accelerated densities are known well enough to compute correct likelihood weights; otherwise the campaign is discovery testing.
facts.quote: An importance-sampled campaign belongs in the estimation lane only when the operational density and the accelerated density are both known well enough to compute correct likelihood weights; otherwise it is discovery.

facts.text: Inspecting a final audit-set failure and changing a threshold in response leaks information from the audit set into development.
facts.quote: Every time engineers inspect a final-set failure and change a threshold in response, information leaks from the audit set into development.

facts.text: To prevent the audit set from becoming another tuning set, keep a genuinely untouched reserve or retire and replace contaminated audit cases.
facts.quote: Either keep a genuinely untouched reserve or retire and replace contaminated audit cases.

facts.text: Access control should allow the tuning team to see only aggregate pass/fail at release gates, not per-case performance-estimation results.
facts.quote: The tuning team sees only aggregate pass/fail at release gates, not per-case estimation results.

facts.text: Restricting the tuning team's access to aggregate pass/fail results implements the reusable holdout principle in adaptive data analysis described by Dwork et al. in Science in 2015.
facts.quote: This is the principle of the reusable holdout in adaptive data analysis (Dwork et al., Science, 2015).

facts.text: Pre-registration should fix acceptance criteria, strata, confidence levels and stopping rules in the test plan before hardware arrives.
facts.quote: Acceptance criteria, strata, confidence levels and stopping rules are fixed in the test plan before hardware arrives.
